Application
Application
If you would like to apply for a doctoral position, please proceed as follows:
The pre-condition for the start of the application procedure is a written confirmation from a professor that he/she will supervise the doctorate.
Under the rubric Research you can find information on the research areas covered by the Department of Health Sciences and Technology. Here you will also find the research groups that are active in these areas with links to the websites of the individual professors.
Please contact the professors working in the areas you are interested in directly, and inquire about available open doctoral positions.
All further information on requirements, admission, and registration procedures is available on the ETH Zürich Website.
